$comment: Alert routing config for scripts/alerts/escalate.mjs. Maps each alert source to an escalation policy in docs/alerts/policies.json. `sources.<name>.defaultPolicy` applies when no rule/event entry matches; `rules` maps a rule/alert id (from the source's own report) to a policy name — use "*" as a per-source wildcard. A rule value may also be an object {"policy": "...", "bySeverity": {"critical": "...", "warning": "..."}} to pick a policy by the alert's firing severity. `sources.<name>.events` is used by the deploy source: it maps notify.ts event names to a policy, "__resolve__" (auto-resolve an open incident, e.g. 'succeeded'), or "__ignore__" (no incident, e.g. 'started'). Severity values: 'critical' | 'warning' | 'info' ('error' is normalized to 'critical'). See docs/alerts/escalation-policies.md for the event contract.

db-monitor.description: scripts/db/monitoring/check.mjs report (type 'database-monitoring'). Each entry in report.alerts with status warning|critical|error is a firing alert; status 'ok' resolves the incident. 'skipped' is ignored.

deploy.description: scripts/deploy/notify.ts DeployNotification payloads ({event, environment, revision, url, error, timestamp, ci?}). 'failed' and 'rolled-back' open an incident keyed deploy:<environment>; 'succeeded' resolves it; 'started' is ignored.

lighthouse.description: Performance-budget breaches. Emit normalized alerts, e.g. {"source":"lighthouse","alerts":[{"id":"<url>:<assertion>","severity":"warning|critical","status":"firing|resolved","message":"..."}]}. Typically produced by wrapping scripts/lighthouse/summarize.mjs --check output in CI.

secrets.description: Secret-store validation and repo secret scans (scripts/secrets/check.ts, scripts/secrets/scan.mjs, rotation drills). Emit normalized alerts with stable ids such as 'secret-store-validation' or 'repo-secret-scan'.
